## Policies

### Peer Review

| Aspect | Detail |
|--------|--------|
| **Type** | Peer-reviewed conference proceedings (not standard journal peer review): full proposals/extended abstracts are reviewed by peer reviewers recruited by the Annual Meeting's Technical Program Chairs prior to acceptance for presentation; accepted work is then published as a 5-page proceedings paper or up to a 1-page abstract in this SAGE-published volume. |

> Source: https://www.hfes.org/Events/ASPIRE-The-International-Annual-Meeting/Call-for-Abstracts/Changes-to-the-Submission-Process

### AI Policy

| Aspect | Detail |
|--------|--------|
| **Has journal-specific AI policy?** | *(see summary — defaults to publisher-level policy unless a journal-specific override was found)* |
| **Explicit permission gate?** | conditional |
| **Leniency (1-5)** | 2 |
| **Summary** | Two overlapping policies exist. (1) HFES society-level submission policy (governs Annual Meeting proceedings papers): LLM use restricted to copyediting/readability only; explicitly disallowed for generating content requiring 'original, creative, analytical or critical thought'; AI must not be listed/cited as author; authors must disclose use and attest compliance at submission; reviewers barred from uploading manuscripts to AI tools. Source: hfes.org/Publications/How-to-Submit-Your-Work/HFES-Submission-Policies. (2) SAGE publisher-wide policy (applies to the SAGE-published Proceedings volume): distinguishes 'assistive' AI (no disclosure needed) from 'generative' AI affecting methodology/analysis/results (disclosure required in methods/acknowledgments); states GenAI-disclosed submissions are 'not rejected solely' for that disclosure, but undisclosed/inappropriate use can lead to rejection or investigation; AI cannot be listed as author. Source: sagepub.com/journals/publication-ethics-policies/artificial-intelligence-policy. Because the HFES gate for original-content generation is stricter than SAGE's general permissive framing, and this journal is an HFES-run proceedings, leniency is rated toward the restrictive end (2/5) with a conditional gate (disclosure + attestation required; content-generation uses banned). |
| **Source URL** | https://www.hfes.org/Publications/How-to-Submit-Your-Work/HFES-Submission-Policies |

**Current positioning (what the journal accepts now):** Conference proceedings paper (5 pages) or short abstract (up to 1 page) tied to an accepted Annual Meeting presentation (Lecture, Poster, Panel, Case Study, Invited Symposium, Demonstration, Workshop, or Alternative Format) at the HFES ASPIRE Annual Meeting.

**Methods noted as welcome (qualitative — not a scored 0-5 table, see Methodological Preferences below):** Empirical human factors/ergonomics research studies, Applied/industry case studies, Cognitive engineering and decision-making research, Human-AI interaction / human-automation teaming studies, Aerospace and systems safety human factors work, UX/usability and extended reality (AR/VR) research, Panels, demonstrations, and workshop-format contributions (non-traditional-paper formats)

**Fields deliberately left blank, and why:**
- **experiential.review_time_months**: No SciRev entry exists for this title (404 on direct lookup) and no forum discussion (小木虫/知乎/fabiaoji/Reddit) surfaced review-time data; this is an annual conference proceedings with a fixed CFP deadline/decision cycle rather than a rolling journal, which likely explains the absence of SciRev-style crowd data.
- **experiential.desk_reject_pct**: No public first-hand source (SciRev, forums) reports a desk-reject rate; HFES's own site does not publish acceptance/rejection statistics for the Annual Meeting.
- **experiential.acceptance_note**: No first-hand author accounts found in Chinese or English forums describing the accept/revise/reject experience for this proceedings.
- **experiential.reviewer_culture**: No concrete first-hand source describing reviewer behavior/culture; avoiding fabricated narrative per hard rules.
- **preprint.allowed**: SAGE's general preprint policy page and the HFES/journal-specific submission-guidelines page were not directly accessible with clear text content (JS-rendered pages returned only navigation chrome); no explicit preprint statement found for this title specifically.
- **peer_review.type (precision)**: Exact review model (e.g., single-blind vs non-blind, number of reviewers) not stated in accessible HFES documents; only that Technical Program Chair-recruited peer reviewers evaluate proposals.
